subject: VPC onboarding: data governance checklist & residency commitments
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Gomez <samantha.gomez@healthspan.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: VPC onboarding: data governance checklist & residency commitments

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the kickoff today. Per our call, HealthSpan wants the private/VPC deployment with a US-only storage boundary and a customer-managed key (KMS) for tenant data. To move the technical onboarding forward, can you confirm the following so we can finalize the setup timeline?

- Are you able to provide your KMS ARN and the preferred key rotation window (monthly/quarterly)?
- Do you require explicit certificate(s) of data deletion when a tenant is terminated, or is an internal attestation sufficient?
- Any additional compliance artifacts (e.g., HIPAA BAAs, specific retention windows by data class) we should account for in the onboarding checklist?

I've looped in Grace (our PM for Private deployments) who will send a compact onboarding checklist and a proposed schedule once we have answers to the items above. We typically run tenant provisioning, KMS binding, and an attestation run within a 4-week window from signoff.

Attachments: none on this first note — I will follow up with the checklist from Grace.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Gomez <samantha.gomez@healthspan.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC onboarding: data governance checklist & residency commitments

Hi Samantha —

Thanks Mateo. Attaching our compact onboarding checklist and a residency assurance matrix to make the scope explicit. Highlights below so you can skim:

1) KMS and key ownership
  - Option A (preferred by most customers): Customer-managed KMS in their AWS account (we request an IAM role with PutObject/GetObject permissions for the bound S3 buckets).
  - Option B: Redwood-managed CMK with customer-supplied key material (less common for regulated customers).
  - KMS rotation: default quarterly; we support monthly rotations if required.

2) Storage and geofencing
  - Data-at-rest will be stored only in the US region(s) you select. We will enforce egress controls at the subnet/policy layer and disable cross-region replication for the tenant buckets.
  - Logical backups: daily snapshots stored in the same region. If you require additional immutability windows or alternative snapshot cadence, note it in the checklist.

3) Retention & deletion
  - We provide two deletion artifacts on tenant teardown: an automated deletion log (system-generated) and a signed attestation PDF that includes timestamps for erase completion.
  - If Legal requires a notarized certificate, we can provide a partner-validated attestation (adds 2–3 business days).

4) Evidence & audits
  - Residency assurance matrix attached maps where data flows and control points are enforced.
  - We can export audit logs (CloudTrail-style) filtered to tenant identifiers for a 12-month window by default; extended retention is available as an add-on.

5) Timeline:
  - Post-KMS access and compliance checklist approval: provisioning (3 business days), KMS bind and network hardening (5 business days), attestation run + review (7 business days).

Attachments: redwood_onboarding-checklist.xlsx; residency_assurance_matrix.pdf

Let me know what (if anything) Legal needs, and we will incorporate it into the onboarding acceptance criteria.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Product Manager, Private Deployments
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

From: Samantha Gomez <samantha.gomez@healthspan.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@healthspan.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC onboarding: data governance checklist & residency commitments

Hi Grace / Mateo —

Appreciate the checklist and matrix — very clear. A few clarifications from our side after an internal review:

- KMS: We will provide a customer-managed AWS KMS in our account. Our security team requests monthly rotation. Is there any operational impact to monthly versus quarterly on Redwood's side?
- Deletion artifacts: Legal is asking for both the signed attestation PDF and a copy of the deletion log. Additionally, we need a short statement on chain-of-custody for backups (i.e., where snapshots live and who can access them).
- Retention by data class: PHI must be retained for 7 years after termination for recordkeeping obligations; other application logs can be 90 days. Can you map these in the checklist and confirm automated retention rules will be applied?

Legal Ops, looping you here — please confirm if a notarized certificate is mandatory or only preferred.

Thanks,
Samantha Gomez
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Samantha.Gomez@healthspan.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Gomez <samantha.gomez@healthspan.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 14:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC onboarding: data governance checklist & residency commitments

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the detailed asks. I wanted to chime in with commitments from an executive/ops standpoint so your Legal/Security teams have a concrete answer:

- Monthly KMS rotation is supported. We do not expect operational downtime for rotation; key roll happens with a short, coordinated window and automated rewraps on the object layer. We'll provide a runbook and a pre-rotation test scaffold.

- Deletion evidence: we will provide the automated deletion log (CSV), the signed attestation PDF, and a separate chain-of-custody statement for backups. If you require notarization, we will arrange a partner-validated notarization; please let us know if that is mandatory.

- Retention rules: Grace will update the onboarding checklist to include the PHI = 7 years retention bucket and app logs = 90 days. These will be enforced via lifecycle policies on the tenant buckets; snapshots and backups will be retained in-region and access is limited to the customer role + a very small ops breakglass list (we will document that list and required approvals).

Next steps I propose:
1) Grace to update the checklist with the PHI retention bucket and KMS monthly rotation option (EOD Mon 5/17).
2) Mateo to collect the KMS ARN and Legal's confirmation on notarization by 5/18.
3) We schedule the provisioning window the week of 5/24 once items 1–2 are complete.

Attachments: docusign_customer_terms_link.txt (contains the DocuSign URL for execution).

If you prefer a quick call to sign off on the commitments, I can join with Grace and Mateo — happy to sync.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product Operations
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
